update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.33 - Fix main-screen stat OCR misreading split digits
Fixed ----- - Reading a stat off the Main screen could misread a value whose digits OCR split apart (e.g. "1279" seen as "1 279") as just the largest fragment (279 instead of 1279). The value is now rebuilt by concatenating the digits, matching how the aptitude dialog and single-stat reads already worked. A more accurate stat read means better training decisions, stat-cap handling, and rank estimates.
